verdict.summary: Round 3 resolves the prior major completeness gap. Section 4.1 now requires a durable, timestamped, empty baseline commit record when a log is armed and after each re-baseline, explains why this needs a separate entry point from the strict-forward record_commit path, and defines the compatibility boundary for older logs. The design also explicitly handles the no-commit case, the interval before the first commit, and the post-rebaseline interval, with mandatory acceptance tests in phases 2 and 5. The baseline participates in timestamp summaries and retained_min while remaining replay-neutral, so it supplies the missing temporal anchor without weakening discontinuity checks. The updated source-composition rule keeps retained_min defined from the ring when the log contributes no records. No correctness, soundness, security, or vacuous-test issue remains in the design diff.
